item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President reports to Congress that he issued a separate executive order; this segment does not itself modify the emergency or legal rights.","evidence":"I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President recounts determinations, transmits the order, and describes an earlier finding; any operative consequence occurs in the separate orders, not this report.","evidence":"I have enclosed a copy of the order."},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The President retrospectively describes the emergency declaration and prohibitions imposed by Executive Order 13303; this segment does not presently impose them.","evidence":"in Executive Order 13303 I ordered"},{"segment_id":"4","code":0,"rationale":"The President reports the legal effects of the separate new order and states a supporting finding; the report itself does not alter the protections.","evidence":"The new order provides that protections granted by section 1 of Executive Order 13303"},{"segment_id":"5","code":0,"rationale":"The President reports modifications, delegations, and implementation directions contained in or associated with the separate order; this congressional communication does not itself produce those effects.","evidence":"Consequently, the order modifies the actions taken"}]}
